summary: Ansible 10.2.0 deprecates the frr.frr and openvswitch.openvswitch collections. Both will be removed in Ansible 11 unless someone resumes maintenance.
questions: Is the frr.frr collection being removed?

answer_card.title: frr.frr and openvswitch deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `frr.frr` and `openvswitch.openvswitch` are deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 11 unless someone starts maintaining them again.
